info.name: Tailoring Management System API
info.description: Role based Laravel Sanctum API. Seed with php artisan migrate --seed. Import this collection and the companion environment, select it, and run top to bottom while the API is running. It creates disposable customer/staff accounts and shop records, checks each role boundary and customer balance data, and removes the created records at the end.

exec: pm.test('returns HTTP 401 without a token', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
pm.test('new registration receives the customer role', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().user.role).to.eql('customer'); });
pm.test('authenticated identity is a customer', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().role).to.eql('customer'); });
pm.test('only assigned jobs are listed', function () { pm.response.json().data.forEach(function (order) { pm.expect(order.user_id).to.eql(Number(pm.environment.get('staffId'))); }); });
pm.test('payment response includes remaining balance', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data[0]).to.have.property('order_remaining_balance'); });
